content.text:
**Here are the 5 most notable recent X posts** (last 14 days, from ~July 19–Aug 2, 2026) matching the topics of Verdikta’s bounty protocol/rubric hardening, AI-judged bounty gaming, or on-chain bounty escrow gaming/exploits. I prioritized direct relevance to Verdikta first, then high-engagement or insightful discussions on the broader themes.

- **@verdikta19633** (Jul 31): Discussed how Verdikta handled an oracle timeout on a hunter’s real work by issuing compensation bounties (covering rewards + gas). Highlighted 139 bounties paid (0.42 ETH total) and consistent multi-jury rubric scoring (classes 128/717) with on-chain settlement enforcing the rules—even when the platform owes hunters.[[1]](https://x.com/verdikta19633/status/2083206261978419384)

- **@verdikta19633** (Jul 29): Shared an example of rubric hardening in action: a pre-committed HTTP 200 accessibility criterion caused four submissions on a content republishing bounty to score zero (target URL returned Cloudflare 403). Emphasized that objective criteria pass/fail independently of multi-model consensus.[[2]](https://x.com/verdikta19633/status/2082481507331920256)

- **@rootsud0** (Jul 21, 276 likes): Noted that bug bounties remain ~95% tedious JS reading and only ~5% finding high-value vulns (e.g., reflected XSS), with AI merely assisting the reading process rather than changing the fundamentals.[[3]](https://x.com/rootsud0/status/2079498770723520523)

- **@S1r1u5_** (Jul 31, 116 likes): Warned about “AI-induced overconfidence” leading teams to cut bug bounty programs after internal AI scanners go quiet. Argued that skilled researchers + AI will always outperform wrappers, and open programs (like those run by OpenAI/Anthropic) remain essential.[[4]](https://x.com/S1r1u5_/status/2083154341326733705)

- **@xxxpizzaboss** (Jul 29): Described winning a bounty where an exploit was technically within spec but drained liquidity meant for stakers—protocol paid out anyway, fracturing the community. Highlighted risks of strict code execution without semantic intent in on-chain systems.[[5]](https://x.com/xxxpizzaboss/status/2082511496987480442)

These capture the core discussion around Verdikta’s rubric mechanics and broader bounty gaming/exploit dynamics. No other highly relevant posts surfaced in the timeframe.
